text: Helpdesk reports renamed files and a ransom note on the file server.
Monitoring shows a large outbound transfer to an unknown address over the last two days.
The account used belongs to a contractor who left last month.
A social media post claims 48,000 records will leak in 72 hours.
A reporter calls the office asking for comment.
The last clean offline backup is nine days old.
The DPO confirms the data includes ID numbers and health information.
The head of office asks to deny the incident and pay the ransom.
A vendor says it can restore everything in six hours.
